headline: Temenuzhka Petkova: Radev abandoned his promise not to touch taxes
summary: Temenuzhka Petkova said the government's windfall tax is a serious blow to business and a bad signal to investors. She argued that the government abandoned its promise not to touch taxes.
why: Windfall taxes on excess profits can alter sector returns and investment appetite, which is why they draw attention from equity and credit investors.
